avoid_menu_bar_icons_desc: On external screens, automatically slide the island into the nearest clear gap when it would overlap third-party menu bar icons (e.g. Bartender). Dragging the island manually overrides this.
allow_horizontal_drag_desc: Enable dragging the panel left or right along the menu bar
hide_in_fullscreen_desc: Automatically hide panel when any app enters fullscreen mode
hide_when_no_session_desc: Hide panel completely when no AI agents are running
auto_expand_on_permission_desc: Expand the panel when an approval is requested. Turn off to keep the island collapsed — the sound still plays and the card is one click away.
smart_suppress_desc: Don't auto-expand panel when agent's terminal tab is in foreground
collapse_on_mouse_leave_desc: Collapse expanded panel back to notch when mouse moves away
auto_collapse_after_session_jump_desc: Collapse panel after clicking a session and successfully switching to its terminal/client
auto_expand_on_completion_desc: Briefly expand the panel when an agent or subagent finishes; turn off to keep Morrow in its compact state
completion_notification_desc: When an agent finishes a turn: briefly expand the panel, just light a green dot on the collapsed island (clears when you expand), or stay silent.
haptic_on_hover_desc: Trigger trackpad haptic feedback when hovering over the notch
auto_expand_on_question_desc: Expand the panel when an agent asks you a question. Turn off to keep the island collapsed — the sound still plays, a question badge appears on the island, and one click opens the card.
question_waiting_hint: Question waiting — click the island to answer
readonly_location_translocated: macOS is running Morrow from a temporary read-only copy (App Translocation), so it can't update itself. Drag Morrow into the Applications folder and open it from there.
readonly_location_disk_image: Morrow is running straight from its disk image, which is read-only, so it can't update itself. Drag Morrow into the Applications folder and open it from there.
readonly_location_volume: Morrow is on a read-only volume, so it can't update itself. Drag Morrow into the Applications folder and open it from there.
show_project_name_desc: Turn off to keep folder names off the island — handy when screen sharing. Cards then lead with the session title (or the agent's name if there is none yet).
hover_expand_delay_desc: How long the pointer rests on the island before it opens. Shorter feels snappier; longer avoids opening it by accident on the way to the menu bar.
shortcut_togglePanel_desc: Open or close the Morrow panel
shortcut_quickPrompt_desc: Dispatch instruction directly to active AI agent (⌘⌥Space)
shortcut_approveAlways_desc: Approve and remember for this session
shortcut_jumpToTerminal_desc: Switch to the active session's terminal
session_cleanup_desc: Automatically remove sessions with no activity for the set duration
rotation_interval_desc: How often the collapsed bar switches between active sessions
tool_history_limit_desc: Max number of recent tool calls shown per session
show_task_progress_desc: Show the agent's own checklist (Claude tasks / todos, Codex plan) as a progress bar on each session card. Click it to see every item.
plugin_session_mode_desc: How to show child sessions spawned by agents, including Codex subagents, Cursor IDE Task/subagents, pi and Oh My Pi subagents, and plugin hook events (e.g. omo in OpenCode)
cowork_tracking_desc: Read-only. Shows Cowork tasks and local Chat sessions from Claude Desktop's session files — hooks don't run inside Cowork's sandbox. Approve or answer in Claude Desktop; clicking a card opens that conversation there.
cowork_waiting_question_generic: Claude is asking a question — answer in Claude Desktop
auto_approve_sources_desc: Comma-separated agent ids. Permission requests from these agents are approved without a card — for CLIs already running in their own Turbo / YOLO / always-proceed mode. Questions are still asked.
auto_approve_tools_desc: These internal tools are auto-approved without showing a confirmation dialog. Disable tools you want to review manually.
auto_approve_ExitPlanMode: Exit plan mode and request approval
excluded_hook_cwd_desc: Comma-separated substrings. Any hook event whose working directory contains one of them is silently dropped — useful for filtering out background plugins like claude-mem. Example: .claude-mem,.cache/agents
extra_config_dirs_desc: Run Claude Code, Codex or Grok with more than one config directory — e.g. one per account via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME or GROK_HOME? Add each extra directory here. Morrow installs its hooks there, finds the sessions and transcripts in it, and counts its Claude token usage. Those sessions show up as ordinary Claude / Codex / Grok sessions.
extra_config_dirs_added_source_off: Added %1$@. %2$@ is turned off, so its hooks will be installed when you turn it back on.
extra_config_dirs_added_skipped: Added %1$@, but its hooks were skipped: %2$@
extra_config_dirs_write_failed: Couldn't write the hooks into %@ — Morrow never rewrites a file it can't parse. Fix the file, then click Reinstall.
extra_config_dirs_removed: Removed %@ and Morrow's hooks in it.
extra_config_dirs_remove_help: Remove this directory and Morrow's hooks in it
extra_config_dirs_more_hint: Using more than one Claude Code config directory (several accounts)? Add the others under Hooks → Additional Config Directories.
extra_dir_invalid_path: Enter an absolute path, or one starting with ~/.
extra_dir_is_primary: That is already the main %@ directory.
extra_dir_is_home: That is your home folder, not a config directory. Choose the folder you set as %@.
extra_dir_contains_primary: That folder contains the main %1$@ directory (%2$@). Choose the config directory itself.
extra_dir_duplicate: That directory is already in the list.
extra_dir_not_directory: That path is a file, not a directory
extra_dir_unrecognized: Doesn't look like a %1$@ config directory — none of its files are in it. Run %1$@ once with %2$@ set to this path first.
extra_dir_belongs_to: Looks like a %1$@ config directory, not a %2$@ one
extra_dir_same_as_primary: Same directory as the main %@ config — handled there, nothing to do here
extra_dir_shared_hooks: %1$@ is the same file as in %2$@ — Morrow's hooks are managed there
extra_config_dirs_added_shared: Added %1$@. Its %2$@ is the same file as in %3$@, which gets Morrow's hooks.
claude_config_dir_desc: Where Claude Code keeps projects/ and settings.json. Leave empty to auto-detect ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, then whichever of ~/.claude or ~/.config/claude-code actually holds your projects, preferring ~/.claude). Set this if you use a custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR — a Finder-launched app does not inherit your shell environment. Restart Morrow after changing.
webhook_desc: Forward hook events to an external HTTP endpoint as JSON. Useful for piping agent activity into DingTalk / Lark / Slack via a generic webhook receiver. Failures are silently ignored.
webhook_filter_hint: Comma-separated event names; empty = forward every event. Names can be normalized (PreToolUse) or raw (pre_tool_use).
push_msg_secret_question: Sensitive prompt — answer it on your Mac.
push_msg_test_body: If you can read this, Morrow can reach you here.
push_desc: Send approvals, questions, finished turns and errors to your phone (Bark, ntfy, Telegram) or a team chat (DingTalk, Feishu / Lark, WeCom, Slack). Unlike the webhook above, each service gets the format it expects, signed where the service supports it.
push_only_when_away_desc: Push only while the screen is locked, the screen saver is running, the display is asleep, or there's been no keyboard or mouse input for the time below. While you're at the Mac, the island is enough.
push_event_reminder_help: Needs Follow-up reminders (above) turned on. Approvals and questions still waiting are sent again; a finished turn nobody looked at gets one reminder, unless its own push already went out.
push_include_details_desc: Commands, replies, error text and answer options. Off: only the agent, project, what happened and the tool or question label — for chats other people read.
push_hint_bark: Paste the key from the Bark app, or the whole https://api.day.app/<key> URL into Server. A self-hosted bark-server works too; for basic auth use https://user:password@host. Approvals and questions arrive as Time Sensitive.
push_hint_ntfy: ntfy.sh or your own server. Paste https://ntfy.sh/<topic> into Server or fill in Topic; the token is sent as Authorization: Bearer.
push_hint_dingtalk: Custom robot webhook (oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=…). With the 加签 security setting, paste the SEC… secret; with custom keywords, add the keyword Morrow. DingTalk allows 20 messages a minute per robot.
push_hint_feishu: Custom bot webhook (open.feishu.cn or open.larksuite.com/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/…). With signature verification on, paste its secret; with custom keywords, add the keyword Morrow.
push_hint_wecom: Group robot webhook (qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=…). WeCom allows 20 messages a minute.
push_hint_telegram: Token from @BotFather and the chat_id to deliver to. Send your bot a message first — bots can't start a chat. API server is only needed for a self-hosted Bot API server.
push_redirected: Answered from %@ after a redirect — consider saving that address instead.
push_redirect_refused: The server asks to go to %@ instead. Change the saved address to this one — Morrow doesn't follow a redirect to another server or from https to http on its own.
push_problem_invalidURL: That address isn't a valid http(s) URL.
push_problem_ntfyTopicMismatch: Server ends in a different topic than the Topic field. ntfy reads the last part of the address as the topic — remove it from Server, or clear Topic.
push_storage_note: Tokens and secrets are kept in Morrow's preferences on this Mac and only sent to the service they belong to. Plain http:// works only for addresses on your local network.
notch_animation_speed_desc: How fast the island expands and collapses
max_visible_sessions_desc: Sessions beyond this limit will be scrollable
session_list_density_desc: Compact shows one line per session and opens only those that need you
session_inline_queued_hint: An earlier request comes first — answer that one, then this
max_visible_sessions_desc_compact: Compact rows fill the height of this many cards before the list scrolls
collapsed_width_scale_desc: Scale the collapsed island width — on notched displays it can widen beyond the notch, never narrower
display_mode_desc: Notch docks flush to the top edge with cutout ears; Dynamic Island floats as a detached rounded pill (great for non-notch Macs)
dynamic_island_top_offset_desc: Vertical gap between the Dynamic Island pill and the top edge of the screen
notch_height_mode_desc: Align the panel to the real notch height, menu bar height, or a custom value
ai_reply_lines_desc: Session list: capped replies show a clean text preview, Unlimited renders full Markdown. The panel that expands when an agent finishes always renders its reply in full.
show_tool_status: Detailed Tool Activity in Compact Bar
show_git_branch_desc: Show the checked-out branch next to the project name. Linked worktrees get a ⧉ marker.
show_session_recap_desc: Show Claude Code's ↻ recap (what got done, what's next) on idle session cards. A new prompt clears it.
show_model_label_desc: Tag each session card with its model and effort, e.g. "Opus 5.5 · xhigh". Subagents show their own model in their tooltip.
usage_tooltip_title: Claude tokens, from the local transcripts
usage_tooltip_breakdown: %1$@ new input + %2$@ cache writes · %3$@ cache reads
show_usage_stats_desc: Footer line aggregating token usage from the local Claude Code transcripts (5-hour window and today). Local files only — no network calls.
show_claude_quota_desc: Fetches your subscription limits (5-hour and weekly windows, as in /usage) from Anthropic using the Claude Code sign-in stored in Keychain. Makes network requests. The token is only read, never refreshed.
quota_login_needed: Plan limits: sign in / run Claude Code once to refresh
quota_unreachable: Plan limits: could not reach Anthropic
quota_stale: Last refresh failed — showing cached values
quota_pace_exhausts: runs out in %@ at this rate
default_mascot_desc: Shown in the island when no sessions are active
tool_or_api_error: A turn ended on an API error (single tool failures stay quiet)
boot_sound_desc: Play a jingle when you start Morrow (silent when it opens at login)
waiting_approval_desc: Waiting for permission approval or answer
quiet_hours_desc: Mute all sound effects during this time window. If the start time is later than the end time, the window spans midnight.
follow_up_reminders_desc: Remind again about approvals and questions still waiting (up to 3 times) and finished work you have not looked at (once): the same sound, and the card reopens if the island is collapsed. Held back while the screen is locked or during quiet hours, then delivered as soon as you are back.
auto_mute_when_away_desc: Silence event sounds while the screen is locked or the screen saver is running. A display that has only gone to sleep still hears them — you are often nearby, waiting on the agent. Sound previews in Settings still play.
hook_socket_taken_detail: %1$@ belongs to another user (%2$@). Morrow can't listen there, and hooks send nothing to a socket that isn't yours. Once an administrator removes it, Morrow tries again on its own.
hook_socket_unavailable_detail: Morrow can't listen at %@, so hooks can't reach it. It tries again on its own.
remote_hosts_empty: No remote hosts yet. Add one below to monitor sessions over SSH.
remote_cwd_filter_hint: Comma-separated path fragments. When set, only remote sessions whose working directory contains one of them are shown — useful on shared accounts. Leave empty to show all sessions.
remote_hint: The host field can be a normal hostname or an alias from your ~/.ssh/config. Morrow installs a small remote hook script and forwards events over SSH.
remote_retry_slow: Still unreachable after %d attempts; trying again in %d min
remote_waiting_network: Offline; reconnects when the network is back
remote_other_users_hint: For agents in containers or under sudo on this host. Lets every user there reach Morrow's socket: any of them can send events and requests under this host's name and see the answers to their own requests, but not answer anyone else's. Leave off unless your agents run as a user other than the SSH user.
remote_socket_folder_unsafe: %@ is not a folder only you can use, so this host's hooks have nowhere safe to arrive. Remove it, then connect again.
remote_socket_unavailable: Morrow can't listen at %@ for this host's hooks, so it doesn't connect.
remote_host_socket_folder_unsafe: Morrow's folder on the host, %@, can't be made the SSH user's alone (%@), so nothing is forwarded there.
remote_host_socket_unverified: Morrow's socket on the host, %@, couldn't be verified (%@), so its tunnel was closed.
remote_host_id_blank: This host has no ID, so its hooks couldn't be told apart from this Mac's. Remove it and add it again.
remote_ssh_field_unsafe: “%@” can't be given to ssh as it is: a host, user or identity file may not start with “-” or hold control characters, a host no spaces either, and a port is 1–65535.
buddy_pair_confirm_hint: Press the BOOT button on Buddy to confirm pairing
buddy_pair_rejected_hint: Pairing was rejected or timed out. If this Buddy is paired with another Mac, hold BOOT for 3s to reset.
buddy_legacy_firmware_hint: Connected in legacy firmware mode. Flash the latest Buddy firmware to enable pairing and richer status panels.
buddy_no_devices: No Buddies found yet. Make sure your Buddy is powered on and nearby.
buddy_sync_desc: Buddy stays live by receiving the current island status regularly. Shorter intervals react faster and use a little more Bluetooth traffic.
buddy_brightness_desc: Adjust Buddy's screen brightness. The device still dims itself when idle.
buddy_screen_orientation_desc: Choose Buddy's physical direction. Down flips the screen 180°.
buddy_desc: Buddy mirrors the current island mascot and status over Bluetooth, and its button can focus the matching agent terminal.
apple_companion_enable: Allow iPhone Buddy to discover this Mac
apple_companion_desc: Mirrors Morrow status to the iPhone app over the local network while foregrounded, and sends lightweight Bluetooth summaries for Live Activity and Apple Watch refreshes in the background.
apple_companion_read_only: Approving, denying and answering from iPhone Buddy are paused until Buddy can pair with this Mac: until then any nearby device running it could answer for you. Buddy still shows your sessions.
about_desc1: Real-time AI coding agent status panel for macOS
about_desc2: Supports %d CLI/IDE tools via Unix socket IPC
island_enabled_desc: Menu bar icon stays accessible when turned off
island_disabled_banner: Morrow is hidden on all displays. Re-enable here or from the menu bar icon.
displays_multi_hint: Enable one or both displays and choose Notch or Dynamic Island independently per screen.
export_diagnostics_desc: Create a zip for bug reports: logs, settings, session state (ids, sources, project folders), recent hook events (event names, sources, first 80 chars of any prompts) and agent configs with keys, tokens and env values removed. Replies and full prompts are left out.
update_available_body: Morrow %@ is available (current: %@). Would you like to download it?
update_homebrew_body: Morrow %@ is available. Since you installed via Homebrew, please run:
dismiss_card_hint: Hide this card. The agent keeps waiting; click the island to bring it back.
skip_question_hint: Skip the question. The agent carries on without your answer.
always_hint_session: Allow, and stop asking about this tool for the rest of the session.
always_hint_saved: Allow, and save a rule in ~/.codex/rules so Codex stops asking for commands that start with %@ — in every session.
always_hint_saved_mcp: Allow, and save an approval in ~/.codex/config.toml so Codex stops asking for this MCP tool — in every session.
card_always_saved_prefix: Always allow commands starting with %1$@ — saved to %2$@
card_jump_hint: Click to focus this session's terminal
unavailable_platform_notice: Not available on this platform yet.
